description: [ĐỒNG BỘ code dev 2026-11-27] Giá trị chào bán thành công (VNĐ) — actual_offering_price = 0/NULL thì par_val của Plan × total_successful_quantity (khác Fact Result dùng 10000 cố định), ngược lại SUM(total_collected_amt); BA chỉ NVL(r.total_collected_am, 0)
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_plan ON pc_securities_offering_plan.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_plan.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN' AND ds_rcrd_st = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN pc_securities_offering_result ON pc_securities_offering_result.pc_securities_offering_id = pc_securities_offering.pc_securities_offering_id AND pc_securities_offering_result.offering_method_code = pc_securities_offering_plan.offering_method_code AND pc_securities_offering_result.src_stm_code = 'IDS_SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT' AND ds_rcrd_st = 'ACTIVE' → CASE WHEN (pc_securities_offering_result.actual_offering_price = 0 OR pc_securities_offering_result.actual_offering_price IS NULL) THEN pc_securities_offering_plan.par_val * SUM(pc_securities_offering_result.total_successful_quantity) ELSE SUM(pc_securities_offering_result.total_collected_amt) END
